rows.grounds: Numeral indicating a set of eight.
Compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) equated with mūla-kaulam (root Kaula).

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching addressed to the fair-faced goddess?
premises: The teaching refers to eight attainments.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The root Kaula teaching consists in the attainment of the eight powers.
uncertainties: The specific eight powers are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
